reviews.text:
I brought my Guinea pig Gus down to have a piece of grass removed from his eye, the vet was lovely and looked over my other guinea pig also as a gesture of good will, highly reccomended.

Also on a side note, a few months back we found a seagull with a very badly broken wing, nothing could be done, but the DSPCA refused to take it to be euthanized, along with every rescue centre we could get through to, along with multiple vetenary practices across the Country, which was very disappointing to say the least.

The vets at village vets Stillorgan kindly accepted the injured bird off us and helped to end its suffering, so thank you for that.
Best vets I’ve ever brought my dog to! Aislinn is an incredible vet and always gives the best advice. The receptionists are so lovely too and I just love bringing my doggy here!

Hello Barry,
Thank you very much for taking the time to review our page and leave us these 5 stars.
We really appreciate them.

Kind regards

Yesterday I visited Village Vets Stillorgan with my 12 year old Pugapoo. I was dealt with by Aislinn, who apart from being lovely, was incredibly thorough and efficient. She advised me to have a teeth cleaning (which Aislinn will carry out) and was very reassuring about the anesthetic. Molly is booked in for tomorrow.
